summary: Gossamer Bio filed an 8-K reporting the early settlement of its exchange offer for its 5.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027. The company exchanged tendered notes for new 7.50% Convertible Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2030, equity securities (common stock or prefunded warrants), and purchase warrants. Up to $72M principal of new notes, 317.6M shares, and 150M warrants were offered. The consent solicitation amended the existing indenture to eliminate restrictive covenants and certain events of default. The exchange offer remains open until June 16, 2026. This debt-for-equity swap reduces interest expense and extends maturities but increases dilution. Watch for remaining noteholder participation and potential stock overhang from the massive share issuance.
